title: The vertical Sunday
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Monday. The aggregator runs a Sunday vertical anyway: they've cut it themselves. The strip draws the cut Sunday on a phone at Gully's, the tiers stacked wrong, the gull on its side. Wood looks once. Gully takes the phone away.

panels.composition: Gully's. A TOURIST's phone on the counter, showing a Sunday cut into a vertical strip: the tiers stacked, the bay in three squares, the gull rotated ninety degrees at the bottom.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a phone on a bait-shop counter showing a watercolor comic page chopped into vertical squares with a small gull mark rotated sideways at the bottom, a thin man and a stocky man looking

panels.composition: The gull. On its side. Ninety degrees. Nobody at the aggregator turned it back.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a phone screen with a tiny gull mark rotated ninety degrees at the bottom of a chopped image
image.notes: The gull sideways: the strip's one visible wound in the arc.

panels.composition: Wood looking at it once. Gully's hand coming into the panel and turning the phone face-down on the counter. The tourist not minding.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man's hand turning a phone face down on a counter as a thin man looks away, no words

panels.composition: The counter. The phone face-down. Wood drawing. Gully pouring. The dog. Regular. The arc ends with the phone on its face.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a bait-shop counter with a phone lying face down, a thin man drawing, a stocky man pouring coffee, a small three-legged dog, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The gull sideways. Gully turns the phone face down.
